follow-up time: From birth until conscription (median 18 years of age)
exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal delivery, elective cesarean section, nonelective cesarean section)
cohort: 97,291 males born between 1982 and 1987 in Sweden
finding: There was no evidence of an association between elective or nonelective cesarean section and young adulthood obesity or overweight in young male conscripts when accounting for maternal and prenatal factors.
birth_weight: Birth weight standardized according to gestational age
